title: Simulation-to-real transfer learning for infrared spectroscopic chemical sensing and analysis from molecules to complex samples
abstract: arXiv:2608.13341v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Infrared (IR) spectroscopy is widely used for chemical sensing, but extracting reliable chemical information from spectra remains challenging. Conventional interpretation is labor-intensive, relies on prior knowledge and reference spectra, and is difficult to scale, whereas most machine-learning methods are tailored to individual tasks or datasets, require large labeled training sets, and transfer poorly across analytical objectives and experimental datasets. Here we introduce UltraIR, a foundation model for IR spectroscopy with more than 100 million parameters that enables simulation-to-real transfer learning for chemical sensing and analysis from molecules to complex samples. UltraIR is pretrained on approximately 60 million simulated IR spectra using spectral reconstruction, molecular fingerprint similarity alignment, and functional-group prediction, then adapted to downstream objectives with task-specific labels or targets. translated_title: 从分子到复杂样品的红外光谱化学传感与分析的仿真到现实迁移学习
translated_abstract: 红外（IR）光谱广泛用于化学传感，但从光谱中提取可靠的化学信息仍具挑战性。传统解释方法劳动密集、依赖先验知识和参考光谱，且难以扩展；而大多数机器学习方法针对特定任务或数据集定制，需要大量标记训练集，且在分析目标和实验数据集之间迁移能力差。在此，我们介绍了UltraIR，一个拥有超过1亿参数的红外光谱基础模型，实现了从分子到复杂样品的化学传感与分析的仿真到现实迁移学习。UltraIR通过光谱重建、分子指纹相似性对齐和官能团预测，在约6000万个模拟红外光谱上进行了预训练，然后通过任务特定标签或目标适应下游任务。在多种应用中，UltraIR展示了卓越性能，包括气体混合物定量、聚合物鉴定、化学战剂检测以及复杂生物样品中的代谢物分析，其准确性和泛化能力显著优于现有方法。
tldr: UltraIR是一个基于大规模模拟光谱预训练的红外光谱基础模型，通过仿真到现实的迁移学习，实现了从分子到复杂样品的高精度化学传感与分析。
en_tdlr: UltraIR is a foundation model for infrared spectroscopy, pretrained on massive simulated spectra and enabling simulation-to-real transfer learning for accurate chemical sensing and analysis from molecules to complex samples.
